comparison.objective: Dispense exactly ten selected tablets from a tray into a held vial without spills; candidate sets and locks a mechanical opening angle.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires controlled granular pouring while positioning a receiving vial, rather than concentric two-tool adjustment and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Scores tablet identity/count, vial elevation, and spill avoidance; candidate scores angular accuracy, nut retention, repeatability, drift, and released clearance.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual coordination is generic; dispensing granular items does not test preserving an adjustment against locknut reaction.
